question: What does Dolby's decoder do to the lowest subband of a downmix channel that carries the 90-degree phase shift, and what does doing the same leave between our objects and its?
method: A decode is linear in the taps of a filter across time slots on the lowest subband of the shifted channels, and the hidden `--joc-low-fir` puts any such filter in. `tools/gen_joc_quadrature.py` decoded each of fourteen streams with no filter and with one pair of taps at a time set to 1 and to j (23 decodes a stream, our dither left out), and solved by least squares for the taps that bring the objects closest to those of Dolby's decoder below 450 Hz: on the first half of every stream, held to its second half and to the second half of every other, and on all of them together, each weighed by its own power. The streams are forty seconds from ten minutes into fourteen tracks of the library of evidence 48, cut out as they are; Dolby's decoder wrote its objects (`dlbac3dec out-ch-config=21`, `docs/dolby-tools.md`) and is run as it stands: only what it writes is read. With the taps in the decoder, the 129 tracks of evidence 48 were screened again the same way (`tools/joc_bands.py`), and the corpus of 131 streams was decoded by the binary of main and by the binary of the change (`tools/old_new.py --decode-all`). A track of the library is a number; the films are not in the repository.
commands: python tools/gen_joc_quadrature.py --work <dir> --pair clips/001.ec3 dolby/001.f32 ... (fourteen pairs) --out gen-14.json
python tools/joc_bands.py <ours>.atmos.audio <dolby>.f32   (every track, before and after)
OADEC_MEDIA=<work> cargo test --release --locked -p oadec-cli --test real -- --ignored the_lowest_band the_matrix_alignment

binaries.how: both built from the tree of main and of the change by `cargo build --release --locked`; the library was screened, the corpus compared and the clips measured with the second

the_method_asked_for_an_operator_it_was_.how: the reference is this decoder with 21 taps drawn at random, a tenth in size; the taps that come back are held to the ones drawn. The reference is a file of 24 bits.

response.how: theta is the frequency of the slot rate, pi at 375 Hz; the response is the same at -theta

halves.how: what goes through the operator, as a share of what the objects of a half have below 450 Hz, and how far the taps the half gives alone are from the joint ones (the largest difference of a real or an imaginary part)

the_same_data_with_fewer_unknowns.how: the lowest and the median over the streams of what the taps leave, solved on all streams together with the outermost pairs of taps held at zero, with real taps, and with the form the decoder had before, a turn by -j and a real correction times 1 + j within the same 21 slots

a_real_tone.how: a tone through an analysis bank, the operator on the lowest subband with -j on the others, and a synthesis bank, in a model of the two banks written in numpy apart from the crate; gain and phase over a second, against the tone that went in. `before` is the turn and the real filter of 37 taps. A unit test holds six rows of it to the crate.

the_library_before_and_after.how: the 129 tracks of evidence 48, of which Dolby's decoder gives objects for 127; ours with our dither left out unless said; an object under -70 dBFS is not counted

the_clip_gain_in_dolbys_output.how: the decode without the clip gain is what the gain is applied to; Dolby's objects over it, solved in steps over every channel, around every change of the gain that stands alone; 0 is the value before and 1 the value after

the_same_track_with_the_gain_as_read.how: the decode without the clip gain times a gain that goes in a straight line from the value of the frame before to the value of the frame over the first 256 samples the frame decodes to; against Dolby's objects with `tools/joc_bands.py`
the_same_track_with_the_gain_as_read.what_it_says: for the LFE the gain is what was read: with it the LFE is where it is on a track whose gain does not change. For the objects it leaves the lowest band well short of the bands above, so the gain does not meet the objects where they leave the decoder; where it does is for the next change to measure.

the_clip_gain_in_dolbys_output.what_this_change_does_to_it: this decoder steps the gain where the objects leave it, which was 1 728 samples before the start of Dolby's ramp and is 1 216 samples before it since the hold is 512 samples shorter

the_clips_of_the_media_suite.how: the clips of `tools/joc_object_gate.py` and the two of the reference player, with `tools/joc_bands.py`: medians over the objects, and the worst object
the_clips_of_the_media_suite.two_that_stay_far: the clip gain changes in br2049-joc-head (and 1 728 bytes of it are skipped) and in one frame of joc-onset-steep; where it does not, their lowest band is at 96 to 136 dB

the_media_test_of_the_lowest_band.measure: the worst object below 375 Hz through a plain low pass, from two seconds in

the_guard_of_the_matrix_alignment.how: the neighbours are the operator with an empty tap either side, a slot more of hold, with the matrices put a slot either way; with its own lag that operator writes the objects the default writes, sample for sample

the_corpus_old_and_new.the_first_run: the comparison was first run with three mutation runs and three other measurements on the machine. In it one TrueHD stream of 2.6 GB ended with an access violation (0xC0000005) in the sample decode of both binaries, three times in four minutes, in the rematrixing of the TrueHD decoder, which this change does not touch and which is safe code; the code section of the binary of main is byte for byte that of the binary of earlier comparisons, which decoded the stream. Decoded again alone, both binaries wrote the same bytes in every delivery, and the comparison recorded here, run again on a quieter machine with the final binary, found that stream unchanged.

above_the_lowest_band.how: the filter banks reconstruct to 78 dB: an analysis leaves a little of a low frequency in every other subband, and the synthesis takes it back out only if every subband was given the same treatment. The lowest is given another, so what is left depends on which. A model of the two banks, noise below 300 Hz, once with the operator the decoder had and once with the measured one: the difference of the two by band of 375 Hz, against its lowest band
above_the_lowest_band.in_the_streams: the_difference_dbfs_worst_element of every stream that changed, above

which: --start accepted on E-AC-3 and the object outputs instead of refused
a tap of the low-band operator, off by a millionth
run_again.why: in the first pass one mutation did not build: the linker could not open its file (LNK1104) on a machine that was running three such passes and three other measurements; run again alone it built and was caught. The other is the mutation of a tap, whose text moved when the table took the last digits of the run of the tool itself; it was run again on the table as committed.

mutations.the_matrix_alignment: the mutation of `MATRIX_ALIGN` that was expected to survive every unit test is caught by the tests of the lag

reading: Fourteen streams of both configurations give the same 21 complex taps, the same either side of the middle: the taps of all together leave the objects 96.3 to 130.5 dB from Dolby's below 450 Hz, 121.1 at the median, and a half of a stream alone gives them to 7.5e-06 at worst wherever more than a ten-thousandth of its lowest band goes through the operator. With 19 taps the median is 62.1 dB, with real taps 13.3, and with the form the decoder had 31.9. With the taps in the decoder the lowest band of the objects of 127 library tracks is 115.2 dB from Dolby's at the median where it was 55.9, which is where the LFE of those tracks is (115.9); it is more than 10 dB short of the bands above it on 0 tracks where it was on 71; and no object of 1080 is further from Dolby's than it was, in the lowest band or over the whole band. The 14 tracks that stay under 90 dB there are the 14 whose clip gain changes: Dolby's decoder takes the gain from one value to the next in a straight line over the first 256 samples a frame decodes to, where this decoder steps it 1 216 samples earlier in the objects. Of the corpus of 131 streams 23 changed, every one of them a JOC stream of configuration 3 or 4 and in its object deliveries alone.
